summary: TestVocabularyCheckCatchesAMismatch proves assertVocabularyMatches can fail, but its errorRecorder test double only records a boolean, so nothing in the suite catches a regression that makes the failure message stop naming the field, document, and missing values — even though that naming was AC3 of the prior i-4-vocabulary-test feature. This chore makes errorRecorder keep each formatted message and has the test assert on that message's content, so AC3's guarantee is checked by a test rather than by reading assertVocabularyMatches's source, closing the ADR-008 gap of a check that executes without depending on what it claims to verify.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: errorRecorder MUST keep every formatted message passed to Errorf, not only whether a call happened.
examples: Current: type errorRecorder struct { failed bool }, with Errorf setting failed = true and ignoring format/args.
Target: type errorRecorder struct { messages []string }, with Errorf appending fmt.Sprintf(format, args...) to messages.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: TestVocabularyCheckCatchesAMismatch MUST assert exactly one mismatch was recorded, naming field status, the document, and value queued.
examples: Only the fixture's status comment lists queued in addition to draft | ready | hold; the other five fields (type, source, trust, finish, autonomy) match their Go sets exactly, so len(recorder.messages) MUST equal 1.
recorder.messages[0] MUST contain field "status", the document name used in the call ("fixture"), and queued under the "only in" clause assertVocabularyMatches already formats.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Temporarily weakening assertVocabularyMatches's message MUST make the new content assertion fail; qa-report.md MUST record this and its reversal.
examples: Change the Errorf format string from 'field %q: %s and vocabulary.go disagree\n  only in %s: %v\n  only in vocabulary.go: %v' to a bare 'field %q: %s and vocabulary.go disagree', rerun the test, observe the content assertion fail, then restore the original format string exactly.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The full internal/intake suite MUST pass, every function's cyclomatic complexity MUST stay below 7, and no file outside internal/intake/ MUST change except this run's own delivery record.
examples: git status / git diff --stat shows only internal/intake/vocabulary_test.go and docs/features/vocabulary-mismatch-message/ changed.

Recorded in qa-report.md.

edgeCases.case: Map iteration order for the Go vocabulary sets is random, so sortedValuesNotIn's output order could vary between runs.
edgeCases.handling: assertVocabularyMatches already sorts both the document-only and Go-set-only slices before formatting, so the message text is stable; the new assertion can match on substrings without depending on iteration order.

edgeCases.case: A message assertion that checks only the field name would still pass if the document name or missing-value clause were dropped, silently narrowing AC3's coverage.
edgeCases.handling: Assert all three required substrings — field status, the document name, and value queued — so a regression dropping any one of them individually fails the test.

edgeCases.case: A future change introduces a second mismatched field in the fixture, which a boolean-only check could not distinguish from one mismatch.
edgeCases.handling: Assert len(recorder.messages) == 1, not just that messages is non-empty, so an unexpected second mismatch is also caught.
